description: Lay out the change days for an HRT estradiol patch from the day the first patch goes on, and rotate the application site. Products: estradot, evorel, evorel_conti, estraderm_mx (twice weekly); femseven, femseven_conti, progynova_ts (weekly). Optional weeks to show (default 8). SmPC change interval, not dosing advice.

start_date.description: The day the first patch goes on, YYYY-MM-DD

weeks.description: How many weeks to lay out, default 8

name: patch_calendar
